section.42: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

42.name_native: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

hadiths.text: Narrated Hudhayfah: There is no one who will be overtaken by trial regarding whom I do not fear except Muhammad ibn Maslamah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Trial will not harm you
